create.name: Beth Grace
create.bio:
Trained as a Kripalu Yoga teacher, Beth Grace is a consultant in Chinese metaphysics who lives in the Berkshires of western Massachusetts. Her main fields are classical feng shui, BaZi (Four Pillars) astrology, Qi Men Dun Jia, the I Ching and the choosing of favourable dates, which she studied with teachers including Joey Yap. She is accredited with the Feng Shui Society in London, has belonged to the International Feng Shui Guild and the International Feng Shui Association, and runs the American Academy of Metaphysics, through which she trains students in BaZi and feng shui.

Alongside the Chinese systems she draws on Western earth-based traditions. After three years of training in Celtic shamanism she offers shamanic energy sessions, and she reads tarot, practises geomancy and works as a dowser, advising on labyrinths, earth energies and the siting of wells across New England, a skill she has taught at the American Society of Dowsers convention. Clients meet her in person or online for chart readings and home or office consultations, and she runs a monthly Zoom workshop that looks at current events through Chinese astrology. At Kripalu she leads intuition retreats with Cynthia Papa-Lentini and teaches astrology for its online studio, and she has made a limited-edition Shamanic I Ching card deck.

videos.title: Illuminating Your Relationships with BaZi - with Beth Grace

courses.title: The Magic of Spring: Growing Your Intuition
courses.description: A week-long Kripalu Experience programme, led with Cynthia Papa-Lentini, on developing intuition and sensing subtle energy. The group works with dowsing, tarot and nature-based divination alongside ceremony, guided meditation and time outdoors.

courses.title: Sacred Springs & Stones Retreat
courses.description: A week based in Bath, England, with daily yoga, the city's hot springs and day trips to sacred sites such as Avebury, Glastonbury Tor, Chalice Well and Stonehenge. Flights, transfers and spa treatments are extra.

courses.title: Monthly Chinese Astrology Workshop
courses.description: A live monthly Zoom class open to beginners and seasoned students alike. Each session looks at the charts behind people in the news and topical events, with time for questions.

courses.title: Feng Shui Professional Certificate Program
courses.description: A self-paced training through her American Academy of Metaphysics, taught one to one with mentoring. It covers the 8 Mansions, 24 Mountains and Flying Star methods, yin and yang, the five elements and the Chinese calendar, with a home project and two case studies needed for the certificate.

courses.title: Astrology and Divination Sessions
courses.description: One-hour readings of a BaZi or Qi Men Dun Jia destiny chart, in person or online, with options for monthly guidance, relationship comparisons and business timing. Bookings are made through her online scheduler.

courses.title: Feng Shui Consultation
courses.description: A full assessment of a home or office drawing on landform reading, Flying Star, 8 Mansions, the 24 Mountains and Qi Men Dun Jia, matched to the birth charts of the people who live or work there. Packages range from a visit with spoken findings to written reports with follow-up support.
